name: Structural connectivity predictors
summary: Computes binary and weighted structural-connectivity predictors (path length, communicability, cosine similarity, mean first passage time, matching index, search information, path transitivity) from a connectivity matrix and saves them as CSV matrices.
description: Loads a connectivity matrix, optionally removes isolated nodes, converts weights to costs as w^-gamma and computes node-pair predictors on both the binarised and the weighted matrix, each saved as a CSV matrix. Use it to model structure-function relationships, for example as predictors of functional connectivity.

inputs.description: Structural connectivity matrix (CSV) with index and label files.

outputs.description: csv files containing predictors for structural connectivity

parameters.description: remove isolated nodes/ROI (column/rows with all zero values)

citations.text: Esfahlani FZ, Faskowitz J, Slack J, Misic B, Betzel R. Local structure-function relationships in human brain networks across the human lifespan. bioRxiv (2021).
